findings.title: MovementPolicy cannot bind the actual computed internal movement leg through the closed selector grammar
evidence: rule-binding-and-admission.md: Selector forms and exact Context roots
findings.observed: MovementPolicyInput.quantity/from/to/resource must describe the current exact move. Exchange emits quote-derived inputFee, output-outputFee and outputFee legs. The selector grammar can only project Operand, Constant, State or the four named Context roots; none contains the computed current movement. It forbids arithmetic and has no previous-rule-result or movement-leg selector. ExchangeArgs contains input and minimumOutput, not the computed quote result. PolicyDefinition supplies one movementRule identifier, while the rule instance format has no per-leg dispatch discriminator.
findings.counterexample: For a valid quote with output=52, outputFee=3 and minimumOutput=40, the actual pool-to-payee quantity is49. Binding quantity to minimumOutput produces40; binding to a constant49 only handles that instance and fails when the next quote changes. Recomputing a quantity inside a policy body cannot repair an incorrectly bound required quantity parameter. Injecting a host-built undeclared input is outside the closed grammar.
findings.inference: The exact source table cannot instantiate required movement policies on all internal computed legs. This prevents the present binding/consumer layer from being a deterministic full38 source relation even if all external authority judgments are granted.
findings.requestedChange: Define a finite typed current-movement context with exact construction and access rules, or an equally explicit closed binding mechanism. Specify policy/rule instance selection for each leg and include its selector/input construction in the work schedule. Supply a two-state, nonzero-fee Exchange example proving each policy sees its actual leg quantities and actors.

findings.title: Several claimed generated claims and reservations lack complete field and identity derivations
findings.observed: ShareMint says it creates the exact declared share claim, but its Args, the vault and balance records do not identify or describe that claim, nor is a claim-template declaration present in the exact profile table. RequestOpen and positive MessageSend carry reservation/claim IDs but require new Encumbrance and Duty records without assigning every required field. For example, group/priority/releaseRule/seizureAuthority of generated encumbrances and the exact condition/priority/origin and beneficiary selection of generated duties are not fully derived. PositionOpen carries claim IDs and numeric deltas but no complete new Duty descriptions. The complete DebtCreate Duty equation demonstrates the required level of closure and is substantially more explicit.
findings.counterexample: With identical RequestOpen inputs, two fresh valid group names or release-rule references can yield distinct well-typed generated reservations while satisfying reservation=P and owned>=reserved. The source gives no exact selection equation. Alternatively, refusing to construct unspecified fields prevents the required opening operation. Supplying a different priority can affect future recovery, so this is not cosmetic serialization freedom.
findings.inference: Finite record type closure does not determine the generated financial state. Missing authority judgments cannot supply missing record construction semantics. The stated lack of unspecified row/formula/work choice is premature.
findings.requestedChange: Inventory every newly generated state object across all38 consumers and define each field as an exact operand/context/current-state projection, an immutable typed profile declaration, a fixed constant, or a specified checked calculation. Add the required closed declaration/argument forms where no source exists. Define deterministic freshness/ID derivations and complete affected-claim sets. Retain full output-record examples and invalid siblings.

eightPureConstructors.why: Explicit UInt128-to-Shares<V,H> introduction closes dynamic share construction without confusing total vault supply with holder ownership or authorizing minting.
A finite tagged payload retains the exact nominal type and avoids an option-record sum whose inactive fields consume node/field bounds.
Exact case projection has a deterministic wrong-case error and does not cast unrelated assets or holders. It is a partial projection; no general total pattern matcher is claimed.
Provides the missing explicit Option elimination. None rejection and short-circuit guarding are coherent under the separately required Boolean /1 semantics.
Explicit widening permits full128-domain products in UInt256 while checked narrowing rejects only an out-of-range final result. No nominal financial value is implicitly erased.

Explicit quanta/mantissa/sign/magnitude access makes numeric erasure visible. UInt128 covers abs(SInt128.min); UInt256 covers abs(SignedAmount.min). Reconstructing a value grants no resource authority.
The exact UInt128 child and static asset index support source-built amounts while keeping actual availability, movement and authorization in financial consumers.

One typed conditional value permits the four-direction vault rule and signed-delta formulas without a host branch. Whole-tree typing/static bounds and selected-arm dynamic work are compatible and observable.

financialModelChoices.choice: UInt256 intermediates and nominal wide product types
financialModelChoices.why: (2^128-1)^2 fits unsigned256. Distinct AmountProduct/ScaledAmount/SignedScaledAmount/SignedAmount/NetAmount prevent spendable-asset and signed-net confusion; explicit128 overloads retain their own overflow behavior.

Deposit/redeem floor and mint/withdraw ceil give1,3,4,2 respectively in the S3/V10 examples. The exact proposed Core body is expressive and agrees with all20 independent cases under its separately stated input domain; zero supply, fees and other vault models remain profile work.

financialModelChoices.choice: Receipt allocation, explicit fee classes and monotone gross counters
financialModelChoices.why: Funding and settlement are distinct; allocated quantities cannot exceed receipt quantity; Fee cannot repay nominal debt; refunds do not restore gross allowance. The per-leg failure order is coherent. This vote approves these invariants, not the incomplete full binding implementation.

financialModelChoices.choice: Mint-to-IssuedDebt linkage and nominal duty conservation
financialModelChoices.why: An explicitly promised debt must consume the full exact Issuance receipt with issuer=debtor and recipient=creditor. Derived debt duty fields and original=discharged+remaining preserve liability; unpromised issuance is allowed only under its explicit asset policy.

financialModelChoices.choice: Partial request fulfillment, claim and pending-input cancellation
financialModelChoices.why: C=P+F+R and E=K+claimable keep units separate. Filling40 for52, claiming20 and cancelling60 leaves32 output duty and gross100. The funded-escrow restriction is explicit and cannot be advertised as all asynchronous models.

financialModelChoices.choice: Payload-only and funded local message closures
financialModelChoices.why: q0 has no cash reservation/duty; q>0 release discharges the matching duty and retains terminal history. Receipt/finality/conflict/absence evidence remain mandatory independent predicates. Generated opening records still need F2.

financialModelChoices.choice: Signed position numeric updates and explicit claim-map dispositions
financialModelChoices.why: Eight fixed slots, signed512 addition and final indexed bounds avoid wraparound and caller retagging. Margin uses exact funded input-output; fees are separate. Carry/Pay/AuthorizedDischarge preserve residual obligations when their affected set and external scopes are supplied.

financialModelChoices.choice: Negative accrual Reject/ReduceInterest, slash-as-burn and rebase-as-rate reference forms
financialModelChoices.why: These are legitimate explicitly scoped models. They must not exclude required ACTUS/DeFi behaviors by fiat; reverse debt, other slashing and balance-rebase targets need justified profile/consumer extensions and unchanged coverage denominators.
